meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For **acne-prone skin in India under ₹700**, the safest all-round pick from the results is a **niacinamide serum**, especially **Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Clarifying Serum** at **₹219**, which is ranked as the best budget acne-fighting serum in the provided list and is described as strong for **post-acne marks** and **oil control**.[1]

If your main issue is **active pimples and clogged pores**, a **salicylic acid serum** is often a better fit than niacinamide for acne-prone skin, and sources in the results specifically recommend **salicylic acid or niacinamide** for oily acne-prone skin.[13][19]

### Best options under ₹700 from the results
- **Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Clarifying Serum** — **₹219**; best budget overall in the ranking, useful for **oil control** and **acne marks**.[1]
- **Plum 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** — listed around **₹500–700** and positioned for daily use with brightening/hydration benefits.[14]
- **Dot & Key 10% Niacinamide + Cica Serum** — designed for **oily, acne-prone, sensitive skin** and priced in the affordable segment on the product page.[12]
- **Plum 2% Encapsulated Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — better suited if you want to target **active acne** and **oil control**.[13]

### Quick buying rule
- **Oily skin + acne marks + visible pores:** choose **niacinamide**.[4][19]
- **Active breakouts / blackheads / clogged pores:** choose **salicylic acid**.[13][19]
- **Sensitive acne-prone skin:** choose **niacinamide + cica** or a gentler formula.[12][4]

If you want, I can narrow this down to the **single best pick for your skin type**: **oily, combination, dry-acne prone, or sensitive**.
